description: Look up the official figures Dadras's calculators use: the full diya for recent Jalali years (ordinary and sacred-month), the latest gold-coin prices, the Central Bank consumer price index (latest month and annual averages, 1395 = 100) and fixed court fees — each with its source, and a mark on any figure not yet checked against the official text. Use it when the question is the figure itself («دیهٔ کامل ۱۴۰۵ چقدر است؟»); to apply a figure to a case, use the matching calculate_* tool, which reads the same table.

kind.description: Which figures: diya, coins, price_index, court_fees, or all (the default).

name: get_reference_rates

links.description: The dadrasai.com pages the result cites, in order.

text.description: The result, in Persian, as it should be quoted.
